r13_contract.comparisonModel: Take the design vertical ice bending moment along the hull girder as M_I = 0.1*C_m*L_UI*sin(gamma_stem)^(-0.2)*F_IB [MNm]. Use C_m = 0.0 at the aft end, 1.0 from 0.5*L_UI to 0.7*L_UI from aft, 0.3 at 0.95*L_UI from aft, and 0.0 at the forward end; determine intermediate values by linear interpolation.
r13_contract.formulaExpression: For each linked case M_I=0.1*C_m*L_UI*sin(gamma_stem)^(-0.2)*F_IB; C_m follows the stated points and linear interpolation.
